_meta.notes: CHUNK-FILE FLAG RESOLVED: the clerk listing label says 'June 2020', but the FORM checks 'Seven days before a primary election' - so the form governs and the chunk file's reporting_period already matches it. The listing label is recorded here as the differing label, per the standing rule that portal/listing labels lie. Cover otherwise confirms the chunk file: Max Burdick, Office 'Council Dist. 6', Office Sought 'SLCO Council', District Number 6, Republican, 2020 form title, signed 6-23-20. NEITHER amendment box is ticked, so is_amendment is honestly blank. Street address, phone, fax and email are black-barred; a handwritten email address survives to the RIGHT of the bar on the cover and was NOT read or recorded. This filing is 4 pages with NO 'Summary Page Other Campaign Accounts' block and no trailing Other-Accounts itemized pages, so nothing was excluded from totals on that account. PRIVACY FINDING - THE COUNTY'S BAR UNDER-COVERS ON PAGE 3: on Schedule A row 2 (Jim Bradley) a glyph is visible at the left edge of the Complete Mailing Address cell and faint characters at the right edge of the bar, i.e. the redaction does not fully cover that address block. NOTHING was transcribed from it and donor_city/donor_state are blank. This is the same class PRIVACY.md already documents for the clerk-legacy era (white boxes that under-cover), now confirmed to occur in the 2020 globalassets slice too - a finding about slco.org, not about this dataset. Row 1's bar covers its address cell fully. This filer writes whole dollars as a trailing dash after the decimal point ('6,000.-', '200.-', '500.-'), read as .00 per the currency convention and noted per row.
